channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Futura/Apex: No 1º turno, Lula tem 38,7%, Flávio, 33,6% e Cury, 9,9%
item.description: The Futura/Apex poll shows Lula leading with 38.7%, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro with 33.6% and Augusto Cury with 9.9% in the first round. The margin of error is 2 percentage points.

item.title: Augusto Cury cobra apuração sobre Moraes e propõe novos critérios na escolha de membros do STF
item.description: Presidential candidate Augusto Cury (Avante) demanded an investigation into Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes and proposed new criteria for selecting STF members, questioning the judiciary's role.

item.title: Fim da taxa das blusinhas avança na Câmara em vitória para Lula a quase 1 mês da eleição
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved the base text of the MP that eliminates the import tax on blusinhas, marking a political victory for President Lula ahead of the October elections. The measure now moves to the Senate for consideration.

item.title: Doação a Bolsonaro e Tarcísio foi propina negociada com Kassab, diz Vorcaro
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro, a former banker, claims in a plea bargain proposal that R$5 million donations to the 2022 campaigns of Tarcísio de Freitas and Jair Bolsonaro originated from bribe negotiations with Kassab. The allegations point to a corruption scheme involving figures linked to PMDB and the Bolsonaro administration.

item.title: Em vitória de Lula, Câmara aprova fim da taxa das blusinhas
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved a provisional measure that zeroes the Import Tax on international purchases up to US$50 and reduces rates on purchases up to US$3,000, benefiting consumers and introducing anti-fraud mechanisms. The proposal moves to the Senate and includes exemptions for rare disease medications and periodic economic impact assessments by the Treasury.

item.title: PT pede investigação de Nikolas e Vorcaro por possíveis crimes de corrupção
item.description: PT lawmakers request investigation at the Supreme Court against Nikolas Ferreira, Master Daniel Vorcaro, and Thiago Faria on corruption suspicions, including flight payments and a mining deal. The filing with the Attorney General brings messages and audio suggesting the banker's influence over the congressman.

item.title: Governo anuncia que INSS passou a analisar mais pedidos de benefícios por mês do que número de novos requerimentos
item.description: The federal government announced that the INSS now processes more benefit requests than new applications received, indicating a significant reduction in the waiting queue. The average processing time dropped to 34 days, with medical assessments taking 17 days in August 2026, down from 70 days in 2023. The backlog fell from 3 million to 1.55 million pending benefits, though denials have also risen sharply, particularly for disability claims.

item.title: Flávio tem 47,4% contra 42,5% de Lula no 2º turno no DF, diz pesquisa
item.description: AtlasIntel survey in Brazil's Federal District shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading Lula (PT) in a potential 2nd round with 47.4% against 42.5%, within the margin of error. In the 1st round, Bolsonaro maintains an edge with 42.4% of voting intentions versus Lula's 36.8%.

item.title: Pesquisa Atlas: Fonteles tem 62,4% no PI e Joel Rodrigues aparece com 20,9%
item.description: The AtlasIntel poll shows that Governor Rafael Fonteles (PT) leads with 62.4% of voting intentions for reelection in Piauí, potentially winning in the first round. Joel Rodrigues (PP) comes in second with 20.9%. In the presidential race, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leads with 60.3% among Piauí voters, while Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has 19.3%.

item.title: Câmara aprova MP do fim da "taxa das blusinhas" e dá vitória a Lula
item.description: The Chamber approved the MP eliminating the 'tax on blouses', allowing the government to reduce import tax to zero for international purchases up to $50. The measure, now heading to the Senate, represents a political victory for President Lula, who secured support from party leaders.

item.title: Crusoé: Flávio ultrapassa Lula no 2º turno, indica PoderData
item.description: The PoderData/Aya poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the second round, with 45% of voter intentions versus 44%. This is the first time since May that the son of Jair Bolsonaro has surpassed the PT candidate.

item.title: Trump propõe "Lei Rouanet" para gerar empregos no cinema e na TV dos EUA
item.description: Donald Trump proposed to the U.S. Congress a federal 'Lei Rouanet'-style law to boost film and TV production in the country, aiming to create jobs in the entertainment industry. The measure, shared on Truth Social, mirrors the Brazilian tax incentive mechanism for cultural projects. The SAG-AFTRA union supported the initiative, though the legislation's operational details remain unspecified.

item.title: Caiado tem 62,4% e Lula, 29,8%, em 2º turno em GO, diz pesquisa
item.description: AtlasIntel poll shows Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) leading with 62.4% against Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) at 29.8% in a potential runoff in Goiás. The survey interviewed 1,214 voters from August 27 to September 1, 2026, with a margin of error of 3 percentage points and 95% confidence level. Other candidates were also tested in various scenarios, including Flávio Bolsonaro and Romeu Zema.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula anuncia redução da fila do INSS
item.description: President Lula announced a reduction in the INSS queue during a ceremony at the Planalto Palace, highlighting administrative efficiency. The measure fulfills a social promise and takes place a month before the first round of elections.

item.title: Às vésperas das eleições, Lula anuncia que governo zerou fila do INSS
item.description: President Lula announced the federal government eliminated the INSS benefits waiting list, reducing open requests from 3 million to 1.2 million between February and August 2026, with processing within the legal timeframe. This 2022 campaign promise will be highlighted as a third-term achievement in his reelection bid.

item.title: Câmara aprova MP do fim da taxa das blusinhas; texto vai a Senado
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved a provisional measure eliminating the 20% tax on international purchases up to US$ 50, known as the 'blusinhas tax'. The proposal, involving political agreements between the Legislative Power and the Presidential Palace, now moves to the Senate. Considered an electoral banner for Lula's reelection, the measure aims to please voters, but raises concerns from the domestic productive sector.

item.title: Câmara aprova fim da taxa das blusinhas; MP segue para o Senado
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved a provisional measure eliminating the 20% tax on international purchases up to US$ 50, known as the 'blusinhas tax'. The measure, agreed with President Lula, now moves to the Senate for review and voting. An economic impact assessment clause was added for sectors such as textiles, footwear, and cosmetics, to be evaluated every three to six months.

item.title: O fim da escala 6×1 fica mais perto
item.description: The Lula administration moves forward with labor reforms by approving a constitutional amendment ending the 6×1 scale and abolishing the so-called 'blusinhas' tax. The Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee approved the reduction of the weekly workday from 44 to 40 hours and two days off with full pay. Additionally, measures were implemented to combat digital currency fraud in ticket sales, enforcing greater transparency for digital platforms.

item.title: Lula é questão de salvação nacional
item.description: The article advocates Lula as a central figure for national salvation, highlighting his international experience and proposals for the Brazilian economy. The author, an economist with a background at the IMF and BRICS, presents Lula as an alternative to the current political and economic crisis.

item.title: Viana quer Alcolumbre fora da Presidência por silêncio sobre Moraes
item.description: Senator Carlos Viana (PSD-MG) filed a complaint against Davi Alcolumbre (PSD-AP) for not addressing allegations and impeachment requests against Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. Viana demanded action by noon Thursday.

item.title: O reduto eleitoral como território
item.description: Organized crime is influencing elections in Brazil, as seen in Santa Quitéria, in Ceará, where voting was escorted by the Army after electoral fraud involving the Red Command was uncovered. Cases across various states reveal the expansion of criminal faction influence over local politics, electing individuals aligned with their interests. Combined analysis of urban violence sociology and political science reveals the mechanisms enabling the conversion of street power into electoral power.

item.title: O povo na Casa
item.description: Black and LGBTQIAP+ social movements launch strategies to increase legislative representation in 2026 through platforms like Voto Antirracista and candidate mapping on sites like VoteLGBT. Despite growth in female and Black candidacies, significant underrepresentation persists compared to Brazil's demographic composition.

item.title: Ô troço agarrado
item.description: The 2026 Minas Gerais election is characterized by high voter indecision, with 80% undecided for governor. Leading candidates include Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos), Patrus Ananias (PT), Alexandre Kalil (PDT) and Mateus Simões (PSD), all vying for support before the October 4 runoff.

item.title: O Supremo vandalizado
item.description: The editorial analyzes the behavior of Minister André Mendonça at the Supreme Federal Court, suggesting his actions may be driven by political and personal interests, particularly regarding investigations involving figures close to power. The publication questions Mendonça's impartiality and the impact of his decisions on the current institutional crisis.

item.title: O STF em ruínas
item.description: The article analyzes the legitimacy crisis of the STF, highlighting judicial politicization and monocracy, which intensified since 2012. Despite controversial actions, the court played a central role in defending democracy during the Bolsonaro government, especially through Alexandre de Moraes. The author advocates for urgent reform of the Court's operating rules.

item.title: Augusto Cury e os órfãos
item.description: Augusto Cury's presidential bid with Avante has introduced electoral uncertainty, rising to third place ahead of Zema and Caiado. While analysts see his growth as temporary, a large base of undecided voters opens space for shifts within the polarized contest between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Atlas/MeioNorte: Lula tem 68,3% contra 24,4% de Flávio no 2º turno no Piauí
item.description: Atlas/MeioNorte poll shows Lula leading with 68.3% against Flávio Bolsonaro's 24.4% in a hypothetical Piauí 2nd round. In the first round, Lula has 60.3%, followed by Flávio at 19.3% and Augusto Cury at 8.5%, with a 2-point margin of error.

item.title: Impugnações de Arruda, Cunha e Garotinho testam novas regras da Ficha Limpa enquanto STF analisa validade das mudanças
item.description: Challenges to the candidacies of José Roberto Arruda, Eduardo Cunha, and Anthony Garotinho highlight recent changes to the Clean Record Law, enacted in 2025, currently under review by the Supreme Court. The cases concern eligibility periods following convictions or cassations, potentially impacting the 2026 elections. The Supreme Court review was paused and will resume between September 11 and 18, with votes opposing the reform's continuation.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que tarifa da Sabesp hoje é 15% abaixo do que seria sem privatização
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas claimed that Sabesp's tariff is currently 15% lower than what it would be if the company remained under state control, highlighting the benefits of privatization.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que vantagem sobre Haddad dobrou na Atlas; cenários são diferentes
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas highlighted that his lead over Fernando Haddad doubled in the Atlas/Estadão polls, from 6 to 12 percentage points between March and September. The São Paulo governor, running for re-election with the Republicans, emphasized the growth of his lead in voting intentions. The electoral scenarios remain distinct, with Tarcísio widening his margin over the PT candidate.

item.title: Lula fará giro pelo Sul com agendas em Porto Alegre, Curitiba e Florianópolis
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, running for re-election, will hold a campaign tour in Brazil's Southern region from September 11 to 13, visiting Porto Alegre (RS), Curitiba (PR), and Florianópolis (SC). The trip is part of his electoral strategy.

item.title: Marinho rebate Lula e chama proposta do fim da 6x1 de "golpe da picanha 2"
item.description: Senate opposition leader Rogério Marinho (PL-RN) pushed back against President Lula's (PT) criticism of the PEC ending the 6×1 work schedule, labeling it 'golpe da picanha 2' and calling the president 'mal-intentioned' and 'thief of hope'. Marinho argued that reducing the workday without cutting pay would impact prices, employment, and increase informality. The clash unfolds amid the 2026 election race, with Marinho leading Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign.

item.title: Lula acusa oposição de tentar barrar fim da escala 6×1
item.description: President Lula advocated for a constitutional amendment eliminating the 6×1 workday and accused the Senate opposition of blocking its progress.

item.title: Um dos argumentos que campanha de Flávio pode usar para se favorecer com crise do STF
item.description: The STF crisis may be leveraged by Flávio Bolsonaro to attract voters, positioning himself as the sole alternative to fight a supposed 'judicial dictatorship'. Bolsonarists claim a new Lula term would shield judges, especially with Davi Alcolumbre's reelection at the Senate, hindering impeachment efforts and weakening congressional initiatives.

item.title: Eleição não depende só do TSE, diz Mendonça ao citar influência de igrejas
item.description: Minister André Mendonça highlighted the influence of religious churches in elections, stating they complement the role of the TSE and reach areas where the State does not. During the signing of a peace and tolerance pact, he emphasized the importance of religious activity for social unity.

item.title: Lula testa a profundidade do lodo do STF com os dois pés
item.description: Lula avoids taking a clear stance on the institutional crisis, risking being dragged into the conflict with the Supreme Court. Flávio Bolsonaro tries to pull him into the same judicial confrontation context involving Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Datafolha testa fôlego do rali eleitoral na Bolsa brasileira
item.description: Thursday's Datafolha poll will be the next test of Brazilian stock market optimism, driven by bets on a potential government change and stricter fiscal policies. The Ibovespa surged 3.05% after Quaest poll showed a tighter race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, while the dollar fell 0.92%.

item.title: Após caso Nikolas e Vorcaro, Carlos Bolsonaro critica "direita permissiva"
item.description: Carlos Bolsonaro criticized the 'permissive right' after leaked audios suggested a relationship between Nikolas Ferreira and Daniel Vorcaro, stating it is 'Bolsonaro with the people against everyone', including more moderate allies. The Senate candidate used cryptic language to describe internal divisions within the Brazilian right-wing.

item.title: Eleição presidencial selará destino de Moraes e Mendonça
item.description: The October 2026 presidential election will determine the fate of a Supreme Court justice, particularly amid the crisis between Moraes and Mendonça. The winner may appoint four justices, shaping the Court’s composition. Lula is expected to align with Moraes, Gilmar, and Zanin, while Mendonça faces backlash for allegedly favoring Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Lula sanciona lei que amplia tratamento de infarto e AVC no SUS
item.description: President Lula signed a law expanding access to thrombolytic drugs in SUS urgent care units, speeding up treatment for heart attacks and strokes. The measure aims to reduce hospital accreditation bottlenecks and broaden therapeutic coverage, particularly in remote areas.

item.title: O estado em que Lula tem quase 60% dos votos, segundo pesquisa do Real Time Big Data
item.description: A Real Time Big Data poll shows Lula leading with 56% in the first round and 59% in the second in Pernambuco, confirming strong state-level support. The data also reveal high rejection rates for figures such as Flávio Bolsonaro and Pablo Marçal, potentially affecting local gubernatorial and senatorial races.

item.title: JOTA Principal | Ministros do Supremo ignoram elefante no plenário enquanto articulam nos bastidores
item.description: Supreme Court justices remained silent in plenary following revelations about Moraes and Vorcaro, while impeachment negotiations and partisan alliances intensify behind closed doors. The judicial crisis threatens political stability ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Lula marca anúncio para zerar fila do INSS; veja quais promessas cumpriu
item.description: Lula announced the supposed elimination of the INSS backlog, a 2022 campaign promise, but recent data shows 1.282 million pending requests remain. So far, five of eight economic promises have been fulfilled, but the pledge to reduce beef prices has not materialized and new labor legislation awaits Senate approval. The beef price promise was negatively affected by inflation, with the cut's price rising 25.7%.

item.title: Brasileirão: Flamengo ultrapassa Palmeiras e tem 49% de chance de título
item.description: Flamengo overtook Palmeiras in the Brazilian Championship lead after a 2-0 win over Mirassol, reaching 51 points with a 49% chance of title, while Palmeiras dropped to 41%. The two teams still face each other in the 36th round at Allianz Parque, which could decide the champion.

item.title: Dark Horse: PGR fecha delação com empresário que fez repasses a fundo
item.description: The PGR (Brazil's federal prosecution service) signed a plea deal with Antonio Carlos Freixo Júnior, a businessman used to funnel R$61 million from banker Daniel Vorcaro to fund the movie 'Dark Horse', which depicts Jair Bolsonaro. The money reportedly came from a U.S.-based fund managed by Paulo Calixto, linked to Eduardo Bolsonaro, with some possibly used for the lawmaker's personal expenses. The plea deal has been forwarded to the Supreme Court for approval.

item.title: Com apoio de Flávio, Mendonça Filho desponta com força na disputa ao Senado por PE
item.description: Mendonça Filho (PL-PE) emerges as a strong Senate candidate in Pernambuco with 20% voting intentions, trailing only Marília Arraes (PDT), who leads with 29%. The survey, conducted with 1,600 voters, shows a tight race, with Humberto Costa (PT) tied with Mendonça. Despite not joining any slate, Mendonça is backed by Flávio Bolsonaro and is close to Governor Raquel Lyra.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio pretendem transformar Gonet em alvo no ato da Paulista
item.description: Allies of Flávio and Jair Bolsonaro plan to demand the removal of Attorney General Paulo Gonet during the São Paulo protest, targeting him alongside Moraes and Lula. The pressure follows the PGR's defense of nullifying the investigation into Justice Minister Alexandre de Moraes's ties to Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master, involving multimillion-dollar contracts, luxury trips, and credit cards issued to the minister's children.

item.title: Quaest aponta empate no 2º turno: Lula e Flávio travam na rejeição
item.description: The Quaest poll shows a technical tie between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round, with both facing high rejection rates (53% and 55%, respectively). In the first round, Lula leads with 37% and Flávio reaches 29%, but polarization and voter rejection concern both campaigns.

item.title: Pesquisa Atlas mostra empate entre ACM e Jerônimo na Bahia
item.description: AtlasIntel survey commissioned by A Tarde shows a tie between ACM Neto (União Brasil) and Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) in the race for Bahia's governorship. The poll tested two first-round scenarios, but only the two candidates remain competitive. The margin of error is two percentage points.

item.title: Nova pesquisa AtlasIntel: Tarcísio lidera em São Paulo com chance de vitória em 1º turno
item.description: A new AtlasIntel poll shows São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) leading the state race with 51.1% of voter intent in the first round, followed by Fernando Haddad (PT) at 39.9%. With a 1pp margin of error, the incumbent is projected to win outright in the first round.
